subject: Compact demo window — request to realign walkthrough to FinOps freeze
messages:
From: Priya Reddy <pri@corefin.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: Evan Liu <evan.liu@corefin.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 09:03:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot walkthrough — timing question

Hi Soojin / Ben,

Thanks again for the materials last week. Quick update from our side: FinOps has put a temporary spend hold across new pilots while they run a short FY reforecast (expected to land in late September). Our CFO will also be out traveling the week of the 20th, so calendar alignment is getting tricky.

Would you be open to shifting the hands-on walkthrough until after their reforecast (we were thinking early October)? We still want to move forward but need to avoid starting the pilot during the freeze. If helpful, we could do a 20-minute sync now to answer technical Qs for the internal review board so the post-freeze kickoff is faster.

Apologies for the bandwidth—wanted to surface this early so we don’t lose momentum.

Best,
Priya
Procurement Lead, CoreFin
Attachment: current-sow-template.docx (referenced)
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Reddy <pri@corefin.com>, Evan Liu <evan.liu@corefin.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 10:18:47 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot walkthrough — timing question

Hi Priya — thanks for the heads up and totally understand the FinOps gate.

We can absolutely pause the full hands-on walkthrough until after your reforecast. Two quick options to keep momentum:
- Option A: 20-min technical sync this week to unblock internal reviewers (no demo environment needed)
- Option B: We share a concise recorded demo + one-pager today so stakeholders can review asynchronously; we’ll follow up with a firm date once your FY window clears.

I attached a one-pager that summarizes the pilot scope and expected outcomes (redwood-pilot-onepager.pdf). I can also tentatively hold Oct 6 or Oct 7 for a live walkthrough—if your team prefers that window we’ll keep it soft on our calendar.

If you want, we can include a small pilot credit to cover an initial evaluation once your PO timing is confirmed; happy to align with Ben on that.

Regards,
Soojin Lee
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0198
Attachment: redwood-pilot-onepager.pdf
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 08:12:05 -0700
Subject: Fw: Pilot walkthrough — timing question (CoreFin)

Quick internal note — Priya flagged a FinOps freeze + CFO travel. Two asks:
1) Should we pre-approve a $2k evaluation credit to remove friction on PO timing?
2) Do we want to offer a short recorded demo + a 20-min Q&A to keep internal reviewers warm (low effort for SEs).

If we offer credit, I suggest tagging it to deal_id CORE-2487 and pushing the neg to renewal discussions so we don’t widen current discounting. Marissa — can you confirm approval path for the credit? Karthik — can you advise if this triggers any special procurement terms for the pilot?

—Ben
Head of North America Sales, Redwood Inference
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Reddy <pri@corefin.com>, Evan Liu <evan.liu@corefin.com>, Rohit Sen <rohit.sen@procure-core.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2027 11:27:33 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot walkthrough — timing question

Priya — appreciate the quick response. Per Ben, we can do both: I’ve attached a brief 7-minute recording that covers the pilot flow and expected telemetry (short-demo-recording.mp4 link below). If reviewers want a live sync, we can do a 20-minute Q&A this Thursday (15:30 PT) — otherwise we’ll tentatively hold Oct 6 at 10:00 PT for the live, hands-on walkthrough.

For the credit, Ben’s proposing a $2k evaluation credit applied after PO issuance; we’ll mark it under deal_id CORE-2487. If you prefer, we can issue a one-time invoice credit instead — whichever aligns with your procurement process.

Zoom recording: https://redwood.zoom/rec/share/short-demo-recording
Link to one-pager & checklist: https://drive.example.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C_pilot-materials

Let me know which route you prefer and whether Oct 6 should be held tentatively.

Thanks,
Soojin
From: Priya Reddy <pri@corefin.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: Evan Liu <evan.liu@corefin.com>, Rohit Sen <rohit.sen@procure-core.com>, CFO <cfo@corefin.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2027 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot walkthrough — timing question

Thanks, Soojin — that is helpful. Two quick confirmations from our side:
1) We’ll review the recording and one-pager with the internal review board this week. If they have technical questions we’ll book the 20-min Q&A (please keep Thursday 15:30 PT as an option).
2) Please tentatively hold Oct 6 at 10:00 PT for the live walkthrough. We’ll confirm the exact date after the FinOps reforecast completes (expected final decision by Sep 30).

On the credit: procurement prefers an invoice credit tied to PO timing rather than a pre-issue credit. Ben — can your team issue a $2k invoice credit once the PO is processed? Rohit, please advise if this matches your PO cadence.

Appreciate the flexibility — will loop back with a confirmation by Sep 30.

Best,
Priya
Procurement Lead, CoreFin
